name: Shepperton Cruise from Cowey Sale
summary: JGF Passenger Boats runs a crewed 45-minute circular cruise from Cowey Sale beside Walton Bridge, following the Desborough Channel, passing D'Oyly Carte Island and returning along the older winding course of the Thames.
reasonToVisit: A relaxed 45-minute crewed river cruise departing right beside Walton Bridge
planningDetail: Usually mid-March to late October. Book ahead or buy on arrival, subject to capacity; check the current timetable
bestFor: a relaxed introduction to the Thames
